# Soroush Taheri

> Data Scientist & ML Engineer with 8+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and NLP. M.S. in Computer Science (Software Engineering) from Shahid Beheshti University. Published researcher (Scientometrics, IEEE) and current ML & Data Science Specialist.

Soroush Taheri builds and ships production machine learning systems: LSTM-based forecasting models, BERT-based NLP embeddings, and computer vision pipelines. His published research covers research-topic embedding and evolution, research-trend prediction with deep neural networks, and machine learning for decarbonisation and energy efficiency in the UK building sector.

## Key facts
- Role: Data Scientist & ML Engineer / ML & Data Science Specialist
- Experience: 8+ years across academia and industry
- Education: M.S. Computer Science (Software Engineering), Shahid Beheshti University (GPA 3.9)
- Publications: 4, including in Scientometrics and IEEE conference proceedings
- Focus areas: Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, forecasting/time-series (LSTM), applied ML for business analytics
- Contact: soroush.thr@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/soroush-thr
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/soroush-thr
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=hhoL598AAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/my-orcid?orcid=0000-0002-5885-3036
- ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Soroush_Taheri
